content.short: Giza is a verifiable AI protocol on Starknet that enables trustless machine learning using zero-knowledge proofs.
content.description:
Giza is a protocol focused on verifiable AI using Zero-Knowledge Machine Learning (ZKML), primarily built on Starknet. It enables trustless model execution, proving that an ML model was run on specific data without revealing sensitive weights. This is critical for on-chain AI agents, DeFi risk assessment, and fair gaming logic where transparency is paramount.

By integrating with the Cairo language, Giza allows developers to convert standard ML models into ZK-friendly formats for on-chain execution. This bridge between AI and blockchain ensures complex computations are verified with minimal cost, empowering developers to build secure, intelligent DApps.
